source: Anthropic published first-party API pricing, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-09-20. Every figure is transcribed from that page; none is derived, rounded or inferred.
note: The CANDIDATE card. The shipped config/cockpit_v4/price_card.json is the fail-closed placeholder and is part of the verbatim port; it is not edited. These are STANDARD first-party rates: an account billing through Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud, carrying a negotiated discount, or pinning inference_geo='us' (a 1.1x multiplier on all four classes) pays something else, and this card would then be wrong. Every model this runtime may use needs its own entry. A missing or unverified entry fails closed: no paid request runs.

field_notes.max_output_tokens: The model publishes 128,000. This card declares 64,000 because backend/llm/anthropic_provider.py calls messages.create WITHOUT streaming, and provider.py uses this field as a hard ceiling (reserved_output = min(asked, capability.max_output_tokens)) -- so a number the client cannot finish inside its timeout would be a ceiling that does not hold. The engine reserves about 4,000 output tokens for a standard run, far below either figure.
field_notes.cache_write_usd_per_mtok: The published 5-MINUTE cache write rate (6.25). The 1-hour rate is 10.00. Recorded for completeness and never billed: the engine sends no cache_control anywhere, so prompt caching is off and both cache counters come back zero. If caching is ever enabled with the default ephemeral TTL, 6.25 is the rate that applies.
field_notes.cache_read_usd_per_mtok: The published cache hit/refresh rate (0.50 = 0.1x base input). Same: recorded, never billed today.
